verdict.rationale: Docusign CLM and AI-Assisted Review products explicitly support drafting, redlining, flagging risky language, and reviewing against playbooks, with MS Word integration and drag-and-drop workflow design for controlled contract processes instead of email attachments (docusign-docs-16, docusign-docs-20, docusign-docs-25, docusign-docs-28, docusign-docs-17). However, all evidence is first-party marketing copy with no independent or hands-on validation of the negotiation/redlining workflow itself, and community evidence only covers e-signature API integration experiences, not CLM redlining. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the CLM/AI-review redlining workflow in practice, evidence of version tracking/comparison during negotiation, and real-world case studies replacing email-based redlining.
